source: Original-season ESPN league-scored weekly actuals, 14 regular-season weeks, full eligible player pool per season; matched to verified ESPN draft player IDs and permanent franchise keys.

methodology.scoring_weeks: 1–14 only; missing actual weekly stat is zero for retrospective total
methodology.value: Max(0, player regular PF - seasonal positional replacement PF)/(annual top positional PF - replacement PF)
methodology.expected_value: Leave evaluated season out; weighted same-position drafted players from other completed seasons, round proximity exponential exp(-absolute round difference/2.25).
methodology.value_added: Actual normalized value minus held-out expected normalized value; positive means above historical draft-cost expectation.
methodology.tag_hit: Value_added >= .075 and normalized_value >= .25, or first-two-round elite hit
methodology.tag_neutral: Neither STEAL, BUST nor HIT; a zero-producing late pick is not automatically a bust.
methodology.elite_hit: Round 1 or 2 with normalized_value >= .75 and value_added >= .20 (display as hit, not a steal).
methodology.special_teams: K and D/ST carry half capital weight; P receives ERA_ONLY and is excluded from cross-era Draft DNA.
methodology.availability: limited_recorded_scoring_weeks is a descriptive stat coverage flag when <=7 weeks; NOT an injury diagnosis.
methodology.draft_value_index: 100 + 100 times season capital-weighted value_added (100 represents expected-value baseline).
methodology.historical_dna: Latest up to 3 completed seasons for each original owner-franchise, recency weights 50/30/20 normalized, 2026 excluded; profiles require at least 3 seasons.
methodology.scope: Retrospective fantasy production vs league's original actual draft cost, not manager roster utilization, injury causality, or in-season decision quality.
